title: Bitcoin ETF Launch Shatters Records, Attracts Over $4 Billion: 'Biggest Day One Splash In ETF History,' Analyst Says
description:
Bitcoin exchange-traded funds attracted over $4 billion in inflows on their first day of trading on Thursday, according to data shared by Bloomberg’s senior ETF analyst Eric Balchunas at market close Thursday. 
“Easily the biggest Day One splash in ETF history,” the analyst wrote on social media platform X.

title: CoinShares Launches 'Crypto Puppies' Campaign to Educate and Warm the Hearts of Swedish Investors
description: CoinShares, Europe's leading digital asset investment firm, has launched a campaign called 'CoinShares Crypto Puppies' to educate Swedish investors about the benefits of crypto investments. The campaign leverages Swedes' love for dogs to create a positive association with crypto and bridge the gap in crypto adoption compared to other European countries.

title: CoinShares Showcases Strategic Excellence Through Successful Transformation of Valkyrie Business
description: CoinShares, a leading European investment firm in digital assets, has successfully transformed its U.S.-based ETF business Valkyrie, which has seen its assets under management grow significantly from $110 million to over $1 billion. This transformation is the latest example of CoinShares' ability to identify and develop valuable market opportunities through strategic acquisitions and turnarounds.

title: CoinShares Physical Bitcoin (BITC) Becomes Europe's Largest Bitcoin Physical ETP by AUM Amid Historic Bitcoin Milestone
description: CoinShares' Bitcoin ETP, BITC, has become the largest in Europe by assets under management, coinciding with Bitcoin reaching $100,000. This achievement highlights CoinShares' focus on product quality, competitive fees, and strategic distribution.
